scope: Two project-authored runnable levels, not an original Snoozleberg level census.

definitions.visibleLogicalObjects: entities whose kind is not zone; includes initially hidden or inactive objects
definitions.clickSources: unique rule.on.source where rule.on.type equals click, regardless of state conditions
definitions.rules: rules.length; a rule can have multiple actions
definitions.artLayers: scene.nodes.length, including actor/goal images and repeated scenery
definitions.baseAssetReferences: unique scene.nodes[].asset, excluding animation frames and variant assets

commutePlanAblation.basis: COMMUTE_PLAN from src/editor/commute-level.js; fixed 60 Hz simulation, up to 6000 ticks
commutePlanAblation.mutation: For one entity at a time, remove contact and motion; replace each named behavior's actions with set(self, initial state). Leave rules, other objects and plan unchanged.
commutePlanAblation.limit: Only outcome and completion tick for the fixed plan; not proof of irrelevance in every playthrough or of absent narrative value.

originalReferenceCoverage.reason: Three partial mechanism studies do not enumerate all level objects or inputs. Observation counts cannot be treated as object counts.
